BEN.note: Letter names no AI law or rule.
Letter names the Digital Code only for its Article 550 on harassment, not for data protection.
Letter states nothing on an identity law.
Letter states nothing on electronic transactions or e-commerce.

facts.fact: CPJ states that journalists Comlan Hugues Sossoukpè and Ali Moumouni, held without trial for 10 months by 24 May 2026, remained imprisoned on 1 September 2026 on charges including harassment through electronic communications, which CPJ says were brought in retaliation for critical reporting.
CPJ states that journalist Angela Kpeidja was sentenced to 12 months in prison for asking questions on Facebook about the December 2025 coup attempt as it unfolded.

BEN.note: Letter states nothing on refugees or displaced people's registration or digital access.
